# ffxf_plan (Data Source)

Looks up an FFXF Cloud compute plan by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_plan" "nano" {
  slug = "nano"
}

output "plan_vcpu" {
  value = data.ffxf_plan.nano.vcpu
}

output "plan_prices" {
  value = data.ffxf_plan.nano.prices
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Stable plan slug, such as nano.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Intended workload for the plan.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk capacity in GiB.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) Display name of the plan.
- `port_mbps` (Number) Network port speed in Mbps.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices by currency. Monetary amounts are decimal strings to avoid rounding errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs where the plan is offered.
- `status` (String) Availability status of the plan.
- `traffic_tb` (Number) Included traffic in TiB, or null when unmetered.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Read-Only:

- `annual` (String)
- `currency` (String)
- `hourly` (String)
- `hourly_month_equivalent` (String)
- `hourly_stopped` (String)
- `monthly` (String)
- `setup_fee` (String)
